notes: Electron 28.3.3 -> 36.9.5 (Chrome 136, Node 22.19), CEO 2026-09-30. The whole runtime is replaced: NovaPanel.exe and every Chromium file next to it.

Why: on Electron 36, Windows' own acrylic works on a frameless, transparent portal window (Capability Lab, ceo-files/FINDINGS-blur.md). On Electron 28 it painted flat gray. Portals still use frost; nothing turns the acrylic on yet.
The Electron upgrade itself changed no app code: no native modules, and no API the app uses was removed between 29 and 36.

Gauge (original) and Flow retired (CEO 2026-09-30, after reviewing them): both folders removed, with their THEME_ENTRIES, theme-cost and panel-capability entries; on every load main.js moves a config whose Hardware Panel names either one…
